show-panel-label.description: Show status text in the panel

auto-transcribe-timeout.description: Transcribe automatically at the time limit
auto-transcribe-timeout.tooltip: When a live applet recording reaches the maximum length, start transcription without requiring another shortcut press.

input-device.tooltip: Optional PipeWire/Pulse source name. Leave empty for the current default. Run 'speed-of-cinnamon list-inputs --json' to inspect available sources.

personal-context.tooltip: Optional local-only context for custom ASR or post-processing commands. Available as {context}, {prompt}, and SPEED_OF_CINNAMON_CONTEXT.

vocabulary.tooltip: Optional terms, one per line. Available as {vocabulary}, {prompt}, and SPEED_OF_CINNAMON_VOCABULARY.

notify-recording.description: Notify when recording starts or reaches the time limit

append-space.description: Append a space after inserted text

sanitize-special-chars.tooltip: Optional compatibility fallback for direct typing on X11. Clipboard output normally works better with this disabled.

cli-path.tooltip: Optional override. Leave empty to use ~/.local/bin/speed-of-cinnamon when installed for the user, then /usr/bin/speed-of-cinnamon from the RPM/system install.

transcriber.tooltip: Automatic uses a custom command when one is configured, then the whisper command when installed, then whisper.cpp when a model path is configured.

whisper-model.tooltip: Model file used when the transcriber is whisper.cpp, for example ggml-base.bin.

transcriber-command.tooltip: Used by the Custom command transcriber, or by Automatic when filled. Template placeholders: {audio}, {language}, {text}, {output_dir}, {output_base}, {context}, {vocabulary}, {prompt}. The command must print the transcript or write it to {text}.

post-process-backend.tooltip: Optional local cleanup after ASR. Command runs a custom shell command. Ollama calls a local Ollama server and does not require cloud credentials.

post-process-command.tooltip: Used when Text polishing is Custom command. It receives the transcript on stdin and must print the final text. Template placeholders: {text}, {language}, {context}, {vocabulary}, {prompt}.

ollama-url.tooltip: Local Ollama base URL used when Text polishing is Ollama local model.

ollama-model.tooltip: Model name for local Ollama polishing, for example llama3.2:3b or mistral.

post-process-prompt.tooltip: Optional instruction for Ollama polishing. The transcript, language, context, and vocabulary are added automatically.
